REPLACE(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(n.content, 120, 1), CHR(10), ' ') content, n.is_public, n.created_by, TO_CHAR(n.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') created_at, TO_CHAR(n.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') updated_at, m.member_id, m.login_id, m.name FROM NOTICE n JOIN MEMBER m ON n.created_by = m.member_id
ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.notice_id DESC OFFSET #{skip} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE ( title, content, is_public, created_by ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, NVL(#{is_public, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'Y'), #{created_by} )
mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.is_public, n.created_by, TO_CHAR(n.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') created_at, TO_CHAR(n.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') updated_at, m.member_id, m.login_id, m.name FROM NOTICE n JOIN MEMBER m ON n.created_by = m.member_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id}
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_public = #{is_public}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE notice_id = #{notice_id}
